quarterly_data.quarter: Zealand Pharma press release: Zealand Pharma announces Boehringer Ingelheim's survodutide (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boehringer Ingelheim reported positive Phase III SYNCHRONIZE-2 results for survodutide (licensed to BI from Zealand; BI solely responsible for development and commercialization): up to 13.1% weight loss at week 76 versus 3.1% with placebo in people with obesity and type 2 diabetes, HbA1c reduction of up to 1.21%; GI-related treatment discontinuation 18% versus 1.2% on placebo. Zealand's CMO looks forward to SYNCHRONIZE-CVOT results later this year.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 13.1% weight loss vs 3.1% placebo (76 weeks)
